title: Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups
exact_target: For any finite X and relator $r\in F(X)$, if $G=\langle X|r\rangle $ is word-hyperbolic, does some finite-index subgroup of G occur as the fundamental group of a finite compact special cube complex?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
